records.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx onError, `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` always produces a non-empty string (e.g. "undefined: ...") even when `err.data?.code` is undefined, so `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), ...)` will never use the fallback. records.issue_text: MultiEmail.tsx:26 — List items use key={index} combined with splice on remove, causing React to reuse wrong EmailField DOM/state when deleting a middle entry
records.rationale: In packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx, the email inputs are rendered with `<li key={index}>` (around line 26) and removal uses `updatedValue.splice(index, 1)`. Deleting a middle item shifts subsequent indices, so React will reuse DOM/state for the wrong EmailField, commonly causing values/focus/validation state to appear to “move” to a different row.
